content: It is necessary to intensify our research in order to propose improvements to our segmenters, as well as to study further the impact of grammar tag rules on segmentation. Since we have a standard evaluation protocol, we intend to carry out tests with Portuguese, Spanish (see BIBREF11), English, etc. For that, we will only need a list of markers for each language.
